contentHtml:
A crisis of time 

In today’s mortgage-broking market, administrative tasks threaten to overwhelm even the most experienced brokers. A recent Equifax survey found that 80% of Australian mortgage brokers feel buried by administrative work. When your day is eaten up by endless papaerwork and emails, there’s little time left to focus on revenue generating work: serving clients, growing referrals and winning new business. Keep reading to find out the hidden time drains that slow mortgage brokers down, practical tips to reclaim your time, and how outsourcing your back-office tasks can transform your practice.   

The biggest time drains 

Chasing documents & signatures: mortgage brokers often spend hours chasing clients for missing documents. The “Hidden Costs for Mortgage Brokers" report notes that brokers lose valuable time locating paperwork, ensuring forms are complete and following up for signatures. Each document delay stalls the entire loan application and adds stress for brokers and clients alike.  

Manual data entry: entering the same information into multiple systems is another major drag on productivity. Manal data entry not only increases the risk of errors but also consumes time that could be spent on revenue-generating activities. As volumes rise, duplicate data entry becomes unsustainable for solo brokers and small teams.  

Following up with lenders and conveyancers: the mortgage process involves coordinating with banks, conveyancers, and other parties. According to industry research, brokers often find themselves spending considerable time chasing updates through phonecalls or emails. This non-revenue work can eat up large portions of your week, leaving little time for business development. 

Hidden cost you may not see  

Time isn’t the only expense. Hiring full-time admin staff means high fixed costs – salaries, superannuation, training and software licenses – that stay high regardless of your loan volume. High turnover or seasonal slowdowns can make these costs unsustainable. Meanwhile, non-billable hours spent on admin tasks quietly erode profit margins.  

Tips to reclaim your time 

Centralise document collection: use secure client portals where borrowers can upload documents, sign digitally and track their application status. This reduces back and forth cuts down on errors.  

Automate data entry: adopt loan-origination software and CRM tools that integrate with each other. Automated data entry reduces duplicate tasks and frees you to focus on client relationships. 

Streamline communication: setup shared dashboards or communication platforms with lenders and conveyancers. Real-time updates reduce the need for phone and email follow-ups and improve client transparency. 

Outsource administrative tasks: for brokers handling multiple files each month, outsourcing is a proven way to scale without hiring. Industry research shows that around 25% of high-volume mortgage brokers already outsource some back-office tasks. By partnering with a trusted provider like Advice Lab, you can offload document preparation, data entry, compliance checks and follow ups, reclaiming hours each week and reducing fixed costs.
